proofs.text: Verify `plugin-copies` is pending on each fixture and not pending after the run; verify the renamed shell plugin copy keeps the name the project gave it and its bytes equal `scripts/proof/shell_purlin.sh`; write a reporter the plugin does not ship into `.purlin/plugins/`, apply, and verify its text is unchanged

rule_text: Every copy under `.purlin/plugins/` matches the plugin this release ships again, keeping the file name the project gave it, and a copy this release does not ship is left alone

tests.body:
def test_every_copy_matches_the_plugin_afterwards(tmp_path, layout):
    root = _project(tmp_path, layout)
    assert 'plugin-copies' in _ids(root)
    _apply(root)
    assert 'plugin-copies' not in _ids(root)
tests.name: test_a_copy_the_plugin_does_not_ship_is_left_alone
reasons: expected value computed by same function as SUT
